releaseNotes.zh: 新增邮箱验证码账号，可主动开启库存、菜谱、照片、对话及未完成任务的跨设备同步。退出登录与删除账号分开处理，冲突可由用户选择。修复助手菜谱的中文单位显示，加入兼容版本的热更新基础。请覆盖安装，原访客数据保留并可主动导入；登录不会重复赠送免费点数。
releaseNotes.en: Adds email-code accounts with opt-in cross-device sync for inventory, recipes, photos, conversations and unfinished tasks. Logout and account deletion are separate, with explicit conflict resolution. Fixes Chinese recipe-unit display and adds compatible over-the-air update support. Install over the existing app; guest data is retained and can be explicitly imported. Login does not repeat the free-credit grant.

publicationPrerequisites: Satisfy current release gate or record an explicit current-release owner exception.
Confirm account backend and actual email-code login are working.
Publish the verified GitHub draft asset and verify its anonymous download digest.
Only then publish these matched website manifest/static/fallback changes.
